newsitem.title: ITALY: TAT Express Italia opens Rome branch.
newsitem.headline: TAT Express Italia opens Rome branch.

text.p: TAT Express Italia, part of the French TAT Express group, has opened a Rome branch office in addition to those already in place in Milan and Bologna, the company said in a statement.
TAT Express Italia has its main office in Genoa and the French group is 66 percent owned by Sofipost, 18 percent by French banks and 16 percent by the TAT aviation group.
Sofipost is a holding company for subsidiary companies belonging to the French state post office, La Poste.
In addition to Italy, TAT Express also operates in the Benelux countries, Britain, Germany, Spain and Switzerland.
Its aircraft fleet comprises 13 Boeing 737-300 QCs, four Boeing 737-200 QCs and two Boeing 727 used for cargo and mail. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
